column1: # config/methods-arm.tsv -- the 3.1 T10 seeded arm: methods-sample.tsv rows whose prior-art lead carries C (x5 or x4 `c`;
#   no proto/pc row): pilot 2, holdout 7. Read by `cards.py --wave W<n> --arm config/methods-arm.tsv` (+ host --x5-fetch).
# protocol: independent coders, one per pack; neither sees the other arm's pack; same caps both arms (config/routing.txt:7-12
#   band of the row's words); verdict on the holdout 7 only = diagnostic-grade (n<10); a tie goes to fresh.
# arm: fresh = the plain pack <prog>_<func>; seeded = <prog>_<func>.seeded, the same pack plus sibling.c.
# sibling (cards.sibling_of): x4:<mmx4 src>:<func> (exact partner, campaign/x4/partners.tsv, ported by x4port.port), else
#   x5:<unit>:<vram>:<name> (docs/leads/x5.tsv col3 twin, fallback campaign/priorart.tsv x5 `c:`); `-` on fresh rows.
# order: methods-sample.tsv file order, fresh then seeded per row; checked by cards.py --self-test (o).
